translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

content: Filemón, imi antin-Pablo tegin anmal-kwenad-Timoteo, anmal-walbogid pega karta wis palmijimal. Imi antin Pab-Jesucristo-igalgin-chunmakedbal oturdaleged-neggin mellemai. Tenal pedin an-kwenad-pilaled, tegin pe anpak mes Pab-Jesús-igalgin arpagedmo.

Imi antin anmal-kwenad-Apiaga tegin Arquipoga iti-karta wis palmijimo. Tenal Arquipo anmalbak mes Pab-Jesús-igalgin alamas. Tenal tule-Jesúsbal-nanimalad-pel-kwapa-pe-neggin-ormamaladga an iti-karta wis palmijimo.
Imi Pab-Tummad-anmal-pab tegin anmal-Tummad-Jesucristo pega immal-nuegan imakelen, nabirin, tegin ulubgin akalzhul-itogal pe-imakelen, nabirbalin.
Pablo Pabga tog-nuedi chogzhad Filemónga
Filemón, imi an Pabzhe kolalil, tegin an pegin pinzhealil, an keg-chulgu Pabga tog-nuedi pega chogalda.
Tenal an itosdo, pedin pela-pela Pab-Jesús-pilal tegin Pab-Jesúsgin penzhulbal. Tegin an itosbaldo pedin pel-kwapa tule-Pabbal-naigusmalad-pilalbal.
Tenal an pega Pabzhe kolnaido, pe Jesúsgin-penzhulidgin-chunmako, pe nuekwa itononigal anmal Cristobal pel-kwapa immal-nuegan-nikamal.
Tenal pe Pabbal-naigusmalad-pilaledbal, pe tar-okannosmal aga ulubgin weligwal-itogal. Al pe an-okannosmo, tegin pe weligwal-ulubgin-itogal an-imasbal.
Pablo Filemónzhe wilesgujad kannan Onésimo-abingegal
Imi an Cristo-nuggin-palmilegalidbal, an igal-nika pega choggal, pe igi immal imakenab.

Tenal antin kantikidgin pega immal kwen chognejul. Tenal pe kwenamalad-pilaledbal, antin-Pablo peje wile, anka immal imagal. Imi antin pato cheredgus tegin an-Jesucristo-igalgin-chunmadiidbal an oturdaleged-neggin mellejibal.
Tenal pe weligwal an-imabiel, pe anka an-machi-purpaled-Onésimo-abingao. Tenal we Onésimo an-oturdaleged-neggin-mellejiidgin an-machi-purpaledga kunoni.
Tenal we machi akpene pega ib-nuedga kwen kuszhul. Tenal imidin we machi anka tegin pega ib-nuedga kunoni.
Imi an naga-tukin-chan-ukchiidyob an kannan pega we machi-palminebal.
Tenal an pinzhajando we machi ilgwen anpak peio, an-Pab-kaka-nuegangin-chunmadiidbal oturdaleged-neggin-mellejiidgin pe-anal an-pentagal.
Tenal antin, an peichul pe-wichulidgin an immal ima. Tenal antin peigujibaldo pe-itolegedbal meke-ibigin pe an-pentako, tenal an kantikidgin pe-imakedgin chul.
Imi an chogdé, Onésimo iché pegin wis wakis ibagwengin Onésimo peje kannan nadel, ilagwen pebak kudiguo.

Tenal pe melle tule-pinche-arpagedyob Onésimo-pal-tako, tenal pedin pul-pule kwenad-pilaledyob Onésimo-tako. Imi antin peyedzhe Onésimo-pilal, tenal Onésimo, pegadin pul-pule ib-nuedga kunoniko, sanal tegin Jesucristogin-pe-kwenadbal.
Imi pe-pakadyob pe an-takel, pe an-yopí Onésimo-abingemogo.
Tenal pe takel, we machi pebi-immal akalos o pegin mani kalenai-dewa, pe melle Onésimogin mani idiro, anid, an Onésimo-anal pega penuko.
Imi antin-Pablo naga tukin chunkalal nermas an pega penuko. Tenal antin pega nue immal kwen chogbijul. Tenal pedin nued wisdo, pe anpal Pab-Jesús-abingajadbal, pe-chunnad pe ankin kalenaimo.
Kwenad, imi an Cristogin pe-kwenadga maidbal, pe an-wis-pentako Pab-Jesús-ulgin pe nuedgin Onésimo-abingao an naga ulubgin weligwal-itogal.
Tenal an pe-kwen-penzhulidbal, an weob pega karta nermas. Imi an wisbaldo, an-peje-immal-ekichijadga pedin pul-pule wilub-okpis anka immal imako.
Tegin an peje immal-pid ekisbal: imi an chogdé pe anka Pabzhe kolnaidbal, antin kannan peje natapo. Al an pei, pe anka kuakwa kabed-neg wis nudako.
Pablo-e-pakamalad kaka palmismalad
Imi an-pakad-Epafras pega kaka wis palmijimo. Tenal Epafras Jesucristo-igalgin-chunmadiidbal anpak mes oturdalemaimo.
Tegin anpak-mes-Pabga-arpamalad: Marcos, Aristarco, Demas, tegin Lucas pega kaka wis palmijimalmo.
Imi Pab-Jesucristo pe-purpaga immal-nuegan imakelen, nabirin. Pitogua.
